question: Extract all explicitly stated business rules

answer.rule_statement: All mandatory borrower and credit documents must be present before credit review can be completed.
A High Risk loan requires Risk Manager approval in addition to the applicable Credit approval.
An application with missing mandatory information shall be placed on hold and returned to the requestor.
Every approval, rejection, return and conditional approval shall include timestamp, decision-maker identity and decision details.
Loan facility setup shall not begin until required Credit, Risk and Compliance approvals are recorded and mandatory conditions are satisfied.
A rejection shall require a reason and shall close the active workflow unless reopened by an authorized role.
Only authorized users may view or download borrower financial and collateral documents.
Overdue credit and approval tasks shall trigger reminders according to the configured SLA schedule.
